Source: published crates.io package piston2d-wgpu_graphics 0.14.0.
SHA-256: 4980a32ebcb703405312b1b460a6fe729f8a46fbc53017805f82c457e2444a7e.
The package is dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0; both upstream texts are preserved.
Pong's Piston experiment patches this dependency locally to avoid the default
AVIF encoder dependency path while preserving Rayon and the other default image
formats in resolved image 0.25.10. The upstream image requirement remains
0.25.1. Only the generated Cargo.toml dependency features were amended;
the original manifest and all shipped Rust, shaders and examples are unmodified.
The upstream example/development Cargo.lock is not needed downstream and is
omitted. Pong's experiment owns its separate integration lock.
